description:
[p0dcasters] Shows in one category (a single lowercase word such as history or comedy), one language (ISO 639-1 code) or on one domain, ranked by catalogue depth and longevity weighted by recency, the same order as the site's pages. Call browse first for the categories and languages that exist and how many shows each holds.
